title: Introduce multi-gpu congestion sampler with sparse-KV replay and energy profile exporter
author: Leah Wong
description: Motivation: We observed intermittent p95/p99 regressions on multi-GPU clusters during mixed-sequence workloads that appear correlated with KV cache churn and cross-GPU memory bus contention. This PR introduces a lightweight reproducible sampler and replay harness that synthesizes sparse-KV reuse patterns across simulated tenants, plus an energy/thermal exporter to correlate occupancy and kernel energy with latency spikes. Scope: 1) bench/samplers/multi_gpu_congestion.py: new sampler that coordinates token streams across multiple simulated GPUs, supports per-tenant priming and controlled KV-eviction pulses; 2) bench/replay/sparse_kv_player.py: deterministic replay engine that replays sparse key access patterns with configurable skew and inter-arrival distributions; 3) bench/reporters/energy_exporter.rs: small Rust-based exporter that hooks into our GPU energy counters and emits compact CSV/JSON summaries for downstream visualization; 4) bench/tests/test_congestion_sampler.py: unit + integration tests validating determinism and seed control; 5) docs/bench/multi_gpu_congestion.md: design notes, knobs, and recommended experiment recipes; 6) ci/workflows/benchmark.yml: adds a nightly job invoking the new sampler with a reduced corpus for regression detection. High-level commits: - Seeded sampler core and API (multi_gpu_congestion.py) - Deterministic sparse-KV player and seedable stochastic drivers - Energy exporter, small C-bindings and CSV serializer - Integration test harness and small test corpus - Docs and experiment playbook - CI job and CI matrix tweak to tolerate energy-counters on runners. Commits summary: "seedable sampler and core loop", "sparse kv player + fixtures", "energy exporter and cbindgen stubs", "tests: integration and determinism checks", "docs: bench recipe and knobs", "ci: add nightly benchmark job". Changed areas: bench/samplers/, bench/replay/, bench/reporters/, bench/tests/, docs/bench/, ci/workflows/. Motivation/context: This is a focused benchmark-lab addition to help reproduce and quantify multi-GPU tail events caused by inter-GPU KV eviction pressure and bus saturation. The sampler intentionally generates cross-tenant overlapping priming windows and intermittent cold-primed eviction pulses so we can surface brittle kernel hotpaths and scheduling interactions that do not appear in single-GPU synthetic workloads. The energy exporter is deliberately compact to avoid adding heavy runtime dependencies to the benchmark runner; teams can opt in to additional counters via environment vars. Testing/validation: unit tests assert deterministic outputs given a seed, integration runs produce similar latency distributions across repeated runs (KL divergence < 0.02 under default corpus), and the exporter was validated on a small on-prem cluster (internal lab) against hardware counters. CI notes: The first CI run hit a flaky integration test due to test-machine GPU driver mismatch; we added a driver-check preflight and re-ran — final CI green with nightly job scheduled. Review conversation: "@Arjun: can you add explicit max-memory cap and a graceful fallback if the exporter cannot access hw counters?" Author reply: "Added a soft-fail path and a --skip-energy flag; documented behavior in the README." "@Sana: tests looked non-deterministic on my laptop CI; please ensure seeds propagate to the low-level sampler and to the replay player." Author: "Fixed: seed now threads through the C-binding and the player; added an assert in tests that repeats the run 3x to detect flakiness." "@Diego: minor nit on CSV header naming and prefer jsonl for large runs." Author: "Switched default to jsonl and added a --format flag to exporter." Approvals: Arjun approved after fixes, Sana approved after deterministic test updates, Diego approved cosmetic change. Merge: squash-merged to main. Backwards compatibility: bench APIs are additive and opt-in; no breaking change to existing runners. Release notes: "Added a new multi-GPU congestion sampler and sparse-KV replay harness plus an energy/thermal exporter for correlating kernel energy with latency. Useful for reproducing cross-GPU KV cache churn and bus saturation tail events." Usage notes: docs/bench/multi_gpu_congestion.md contains experiment recipes for reproducing p95/p99 spikes, recommended knobs (seed, skew, inter-arrival, eviction pulse frequency), and guidance for correlating exporter output with per-kernel latency. Related: ENG-4523 (investigation), ENG-4598 (follow-up action: prefetch-policy experiments).
